title: tenant-states record value v1
description: The value of one record in topic tenant-states, written by Tenant Management. Key: tenant_id as UTF-8 bytes. The examples are what Tenant Management's and the API Gateway's tests run against (README.md).

tenant_id.description: Zitadel Organization ID of the tenant; equals the record key.

state.description: The tenant's state in Tenant Management (ADR-0012, item 3).

at.description: When Tenant Management published the record, UTC.
